items.title: Markets roar back: Top 10 firms add Rs 2.5 lakh cr in a week; Bajaj Finance leads gains
items.description: Reliance Industries continued to hold the top spot in India's market-cap ranking, followed by Bharti Airtel, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, State Bank of India, TCS, Bajaj Finance, Larsen & Toubro, LIC and Hindustan Unilever.

items.title: FPIs return to India after 4-month selloff, pump Rs 20,200 crore into equities
items.description: FPIs pulled out Rs 49,340 crore in June, Rs 32,963 crore in May, Rs 60,847 crore in April and a steep Rs 1.17 lakh crore in March.

items.title: Broader markets rebound; midcap, smallcap indices snap two-week losing streak
items.description: The Nifty index now appears well-positioned to inch towards the 24,600 level, which coincides with the previous swing high, and a decisive breakout above this zone could open the door for a move towards the 24,800-25,000 mark, says Ajit Mishra – SVP, Research, Religare Broking.

items.title: Crushed by Kospi rout, angry Koreans rip Lee and vow not to buy
items.description: Retail investors sold a record amount of Kospi shares on Friday despite a stunning 18% rebound. The gauge still capped a 22% loss for the month, the steepest since the global financial crisis.
